## Versions

Agent, adapter, PowerShell, provider app, and Windows versions:

## Sanitized reproduction

Steps, expected result, and actual result. Include only safe Doctor output.

## Privacy checklist

- [ ] I removed device keys, ntfy tokens, provider endpoints, prompt/output text, task IDs, and local paths.
- [ ] I did not attach runtime data, credentials, DPAPI files, or logs.
